description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.8 — unify image and video long-press link icons

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF from post options and direct image/video/GIF URL from media long-press). Existing filters are retained. The native image/video long-press action sheet gets a separate Copy media URL row without replacing built-in actions. Direct video/GIF URLs prefer the highest-bitrate MP4. The obsolete video downloader hook was removed because it does not match X 12.31.0. The presenter handler lookup was hardened for the Ahmed 1.24.2 coexistence case observed failing in x.3. Version x.7 fixes the normal loop-exit branch skipping the row insertion by transforming the finished immutable media sheet instead of injecting immediately before its conversion. The original rows and selection handler remain intact. Version x.8 only changes the added image long-press row to reuse X 12.31's native video copy-link chain icon (com.x.icons.a.h5); the video row, URL handlers, other five features and Ahmed coexistence remain unchanged. The x.7 image/video long-press rows were observed on-device, and the new icon appearance requires verification after installation.

patches.name: Copy media URL
patches.description: Copies direct image/video/GIF URLs from long-press or post options.

patches.name: Fix external post links
patches.description: Opens external X post URLs directly in post detail without using the For You tab.

patches.name: Hide Find more
patches.description: Hides Discover more / もっと見つける under posts and top people recommendations in Search.

patches.name: Hide Who to follow
patches.description: Hides Who to follow / recommended-account modules from timelines.

patches.name: Hide search relevance prompt
patches.description: Hides only the Is this post relevant to your search? Yes/No prompt in X Search results.

patches.name: Hide sports scores
patches.description: Experimental: hides live sports game pills at the top of X Home, preserving live-stream pills.

release_notes: X Patch unifies all six opt-in features for X 12.31/12.32, including sports scores, search relevance prompts and media URL copy. On-device behavior of newer features remains unverified.
